task.description: WF-02, step 7, DESIGN-QA second pass - compares the built public pages (index, how, examples, demo, 404) of task M1.4 (REQ-111, REQ-112) at the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review5 with the approved v3 sample and the edited docs/design/V1-public-look.md in a real Chrome 157, from a fresh clone, windows 1470x784, 390x844, 320x568, 360x640, 379x640 and 380x640, two themes, ru, en and kk (local), with and without scripts; confirms N1, N2, N3 of the first pass, checks the edited look against the built page, and prepares the owner's showing.

summary: Verdict PASS. Sample kind: sample and description. No Critical, High or Medium finding is left. The three findings of the first pass are closed on the built page: N1 (the speaker title in its column at every width 320-420 px step 4, ru/kk/en, both themes, five questions: 780 checks, 0 issues; the own row below 380 px, side by side from 380 px; 315 more checks that the title, the count, the pips, the question and «‹ Назад» never overlap each other or the cards: 0 bad), N2 (every chip is named «<question>: <answer>» by aria-label, no title, in ru/kk/en; five «Не знаю» chips are five different names), N3 (the all-«Не знаю» receipt now reads «Если данные должны храниться на всех устройствах, нужен сервер, а серверы Sai пока не делает.» in ru, kk and en).

Eight new Low findings (N4-N11), all about the edited look, one record and one code comment, and one wording question; none breaks the one-to-one match with the sample. The edited look is TRUE where it was measured: every [M build] value of 7.9, 7.11 and 12 and D23, D25, D26 reproduced (see self_check), with two count mismatches (N4) and five stale places the edit left alone (N5-N8, N10 is a code comment).

What was compared on the final code: index, how, examples, demo (the five questions with «Вы» standing and 12 kinds of result: lead plus one, clear leader of each of six products, close options, no match, all «Не знаю») and 404 at 1470x784, 390x844, 320x568, 360x640, 379x640 and 380x640, light and dark, ru, en and kk (local set), with scripts (180 page states with a full-page twin each, 144 question states, 222 result states with a full-page twin each) and without scripts (30 states with twins), against the sample's shots and the sample rendered in the same Chrome (30 shots). Against the first pass, pixel by pixel: the 255 shots of index, how, examples, 404 and no-script pages that have a first-pass twin are identical; on the demo only 360 px changed (24 question shots, the new own row) and the no-match and all-«Не знаю» receipts (92 result shots, the new text); the other 65 result shots differ by 14 pixels or fewer, and the question shots at 1470, 390 and 320 by 8 pixels or fewer or by a hover edge of a card (the pointer was parked differently).

Truth and rules: the test-mode line, the AI disclosure and `noindex` on every page in ru, en and kk; the scene caption on index, how and demo (not on examples and 404, as the look says); the first-load texts of all 15 page/language pairs are byte-equal to the first pass; no agent event, no time, no counter, no personal staff name, no sample tenant word, no price in any visible text, aria-label or sr text (the only date is the receipt's real date of the visit, which the look asks for); nothing moves by itself (index, how, demo at 1470 and 320: 4 s idle gives 0 draws, 0 requestAnimationFrame calls, 0 CSS animations, 0 setInterval; a walk ends and then 0 draws in 4 s; reduced motion places «Вы» at once). Machine audit on 756 states: no horizontal scroll, no target under 44 px, no text under 4.5:1 (3:1 large), no text beyond the viewport except the scene's own plates that the stage clips by design (D10), no console message and no failed request.

Owner's showing: 29 pictures and README.txt in Russian in <scratch>/owner-shots/ (sample next to built page for the landing light and dark, the question and the result; the landing and the demo on 390x844 in light and dark; 320x568 landing and two questions; five scene states; no-match results; examples and how).

The comment does not name 380.

findings.question: truth of a text (a question to REQ-111)
findings.place: demo.html result without a match, the receipt text (app/content/sai-intake.json, result.no_match_text)
findings.what: The conditional wording fixes N3 for the all-«Не знаю» case. A no-match result also comes with too few answers and no server answer: of the 900 combinations of answers the engine gives 13 no-match results with storage «Нет, не нужно» or unanswered (for example only «Клиенты и посетители» and «Нет, не нужно»; only «Внешний вид и текст»). There the receipt still explains the missing product by the server: «По этим ответам Sai пока не может собрать подходящий продукт. Если данные должны храниться на всех устройствах, нужен сервер, а серверы Sai пока не делает.» The sentence is conditional and not false, but it is not the visitor's reason.
findings.fix: A question to ORCH and REQ-111 (the texts are the requirement's): either a second no-match line for «not enough answers» («Ответов пока мало, чтобы подобрать продукт.»), or accept as is and write it in decisions/0124.
